meta.title: Vendor card rank and colour only while the auction runs, never on a sealed stage
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The available vocabulary cannot create or read a second sealed-bids auction in the same fresh record.
Traffic colour has no read-back field or assertion path.
There is no operation for the required vendor revisions, so the condition that rank appears only after those revisions is not checked.
The vocabulary does not support ordered read-backs before start, during the open auction, and after its end; only the post-close absence check is included.
what the screen shows (an API plan checks the data, not the page)
warnings: verify 1: read_indicators's reply shape has not been sampled; "auction_identifiers_data.{{vendorUuid}}.inline.{{lineItemUuid}}.rank" is unverified

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for only about two minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live pricing round.
The buyer converts the pricing round into a live auction.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
A second QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
Wait until the round's bid end time has passed.
As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that Schema check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank” is absent.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Schema check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank” is absent.
